verdict.rationale: Environments (dev/staging/prod variable sets) are a core, well-known Postman feature, but the evidence pack contains no explicit citation describing environment switching or environment variable management—only adjacent features like Vault (secrets), scripts, and CLI. Absence of direct evidence for this applicable capability means it cannot be credited. Missing for 10: any doc or hands-on reference to Postman Environments, environment variable scoping, or switching between environment sets.
